name: arch-crew
description: A cross-agent suite of architectural-decision skills for selecting new designs or reviewing existing code against explicit pattern trade-offs.

claude.description: A suite of architectural-decision skills for Claude Code: decide-architecture (software architecture stack), design-patterns (GoF + Python-idiomatic patterns), agentic-patterns (LLM-agent control-flow design), and test-patterns (risk-led testing portfolio across quality practices, unit / integration / contract / end-to-end tests, and data / ML / LLM evaluation, with an oracle-independence guardrail over generated tests). Each skill branches on project status — greenfield runs a short selection interview and recommends a composed design; refactoring reviews existing code against the catalog and proposes targeted moves.

codex.description: A suite of architectural-decision skills for Codex: decide-architecture, design-patterns, agentic-patterns, and test-patterns. Each skill guides a selection interview for new work or a focused review of existing code.
